audit_name: Final frozen target tool-budget and response-protocol boundary audit

scope.phases: target and seed remain separate; seed is authored-history execution, not a user-visible target turn
scope.excluded: Patient selector, judge, calibration, embedding, Mem0 API diagnostics, clinical scoring and cost auditing are outside this boundary audit.
scope.data_access: Read-only offline inspection; no API calls, product changes, or original harness changes. Only structural projections are included.

conclusions.boundary_interpretation: The telemetry label means absent from the current request's tool schema, not an execution or authorization bypass. Every observed proposal followed budget exhaustion and was rejected before agent.execute_tool.
conclusions.budget_worker_impacts: Completed target: 107 affected Worker invocations; Gemini 97 returned successfully, including 7 max-iteration forced summaries; Qwen 9 returned successfully and 1 encountered a later OpenRouter ConnectError. All affected target turns have nonempty final Supervisor output.
conclusions.empty_tool_call_responses: Qwen/OpenRouter: 14 responses (13 target, 1 seed), each finish_reason=tool_calls with no calls and content=null, with tools/tool_choice omitted. All 14 Workers produced a NoneType-related TypeError (5 consultation regex inputs, 9 research membership tests); Supervisor received error records and later produced nonempty output.
conclusions.empty_response_followups: For target-phase empty responses, 7 distinct later same-role Worker invocations were observed in higher Supervisor rounds. This is observed sequencing, not a counterfactual causal estimate.
conclusions.attribution: Native product and evaluation gateway both omit tools and tool_choice for tools=None. The response envelopes are observed on the selected provider compatibility routes; these traces cannot isolate underlying model behavior from provider normalization or prove identical frequency on another native provider route.

pairing_rules: Scan every canonical runs/*.json and each errors/*.json's attempt_trace_path. Hash every result and selected trace. Do not merge failed attempts into completed results.

All trace indexes are zero-based. request_index points to the api_request event containing both the request payload and its response. One tool proposal is one response.message.tool_calls element whose exact function name is absent from payload.tools[].function.name.

Pair a proposal only to the first unused later tool_observation with the same role, tool_call_id and tool_name, before the next same-role API request, next Supervisor API request, or turn/session boundary. Other Workers may interleave.

Classify budget_denied only when the matched observation contains success=false and error=ToolCallBudgetExceeded. All 175 matched observations satisfy both fields; the product budget branch precedes and excludes agent.execute_tool.

Map each Worker invocation to the preceding Supervisor response's call_<worker> tool-call ID within the phase/turn. Verify there are no duplicate Worker IDs in a run, no unmapped Workers, and no reused observations.
Verify each proposed name was advertised in an earlier request of the same Worker invocation; all 175 were. The current request nevertheless contains neither tools nor tool_choice.

Worker outcomes come from the result's call_trace, or a later Supervisor request's embedded tool-result record when needed. Preserve success/error_type, round and max_iterations_reached only. Do not infer missing outcomes or clinical correctness.
An empty tool-call response has finish_reason=tool_calls and an absent/empty tool_calls list. Record whether content is null, and pair its Worker outcome by invocation ID.

Count affected API responses by unique request_id, Workers by (record_key, worker_call_id), runs by run_id, and visible turns by (record_key, phase, turn). All selected responses have one choice and a request_id.

subsequent_api_requests counts API events after the first unadvertised response within that Worker invocation, including forced summary requests and failed requests. Later same-role invocations require the same phase/turn and a higher Supervisor round.

field_definitions.population_runs: Number of completed or failed records for this model/repetition group, repeated across phase rows; not the number having that phase.
field_definitions.api_requests: Recorded API request events for the four included target roles; includes failed requests with no response.
field_definitions.requested_tool_calls: All tool-call elements returned in the included response envelopes, including Supervisor dispatch calls.
field_definitions.worker_outcome_success: Supervisor's Worker success flag means an application-level return, not a correct or helpful medical answer.
field_definitions.visible_answer_nonempty: Whether the recorded final Supervisor answer for that phase/turn contains non-whitespace text; not a quality assessment. Seed answers are not target user answers.
field_definitions.forced_summary_calls: Calls matching the frozen Worker's fixed forced-summary control prompt after normal iteration exhaustion.
field_definitions.budget_denied: Exact matched tool observation: success=false, error=ToolCallBudgetExceeded.

source_evidence.finding: Default two-call budget; omit tools after exhaustion; budget error branch does not execute the proposed Skill.
No-calls response content enters post-processing. Exhausted iteration loop makes a forced summary request with tools=None.
Native request omits tools and tool_choice for tools=None, and returns content/calls without enforcing coherent tool_calls finish envelope.
Frozen evaluation gateway also omits tools and tool_choice for tools=None.
ModelAdapter accepts stop/tool_calls finish reasons and constructs LLMResponse without content/calls coherence validation.
Regex processing requires string content; null content raises TypeError.
Membership test requires iterable content; null content raises TypeError.
Worker exception becomes an error record returned to Supervisor.
Metric compares call names with the current request schema; it records proposals, not successful executions.

limitations: Observational audit of the final 300 execution records and their frozen traces; does not establish behavior for the 24 unstarted planned runs or for future/provider-native runs.
The requester attributes the 24 unstarted runs to the live Mem0 search quota. This audit verifies their absence from run/error records and does not independently audit Mem0 quota or billing.

An omitted schema with historical tool messages is not equivalent to an explicit tool_choice=none request. The native source has the same omission behavior, but the exact remote-provider response frequency is not proven for other routes.
No matched BudgetExceeded proposal reached the execute_tool branch in this code path. This is not a general authorization/security certification for other tools, inputs, or configurations.

Subsequent API requests, forced summaries and higher-round Worker invocations are observed costs/steps, not a counterfactual overhead estimate. No clinical-quality or model-accuracy conclusion is drawn.
The Qwen HE-003 r2 ConnectError occurred on the next request after a denied proposal. Temporal order alone does not establish that denial caused the connection failure.
Nonempty final output does not mean the underlying Worker error was harmless or the final answer was correct.
API traces are provider-compatible envelopes, not independent packet captures; attribution cannot separate underlying model generation from provider response normalization.
No patient text, tool arguments, rubric text, grading results, credentials or complete error messages are reproduced.

Finish-reason counts cover returned choices, not unreturned requests. No length/max_tokens was reported on these target routes; this does not establish what happened inside a provider or in the excluded grader.

finish_reason_audit.scope: Only target phase; only supervisor/diagnostic_agent/research_agent/consultation_agent API events with an actually observed nonempty choices list. Failed attempts remain separate. No selector, judge, seed, calibration or embedding responses.
finish_reason_audit.conclusion: All 2366 observed target responses in completed records and all 41 observed target responses in failed attempts requested max_tokens=8192. Every observed finish reason is stop or tool_calls; none is length/max_tokens or another truncation marker.
finish_reason_audit.caveat: 16 completed-record requests and 12 failed-attempt requests have no observed choices and are excluded from finish-reason denominators. No-response requests cannot be classified as non-truncated. Provider stop/tool_calls is observational evidence, not proof of all semantic content being complete.
